info.amfiName: Aditya Birla Sun Life BSE India Infrastructure Index Fund
info.cat: Open Ended Schemes(Index Funds - Equity Funds)
info.objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to provide returns that, before expenses, correspond to the total returns of securities as represented by the BSE India Infrastructure Total Return Index, subject to tracking errors. The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
info.benchmark: BSE India Infrastructure Total Return Index

alloc.label: Equity & Equity related securities constituting the BSE India Infrastructure Index

extra.type: An open ended Index Fund replicating the BSE India Infrastructure Total Return Index

info.amfiName: Tata Nifty500 Multicap Infrastructure 50:30:20 Index Fund
info.cat: Open Ended Schemes(Other Scheme - Index Funds)
info.objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns, before expenses, that are in line with the performance of Nifty500 Multicap Infrastructure 50:30:20 Index (TRI), subject to tracking error. However ,there is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved. The scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns.
exitLoad: 0.25% of the applicable NAV, if redeemed on or before 15 days from the date of allotment.

extra.allotment: within 5 (five) working / business days from the date of closure of the NFO Period
extra.type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking Nifty500 Multicap Infrastructure 50:30:20 Index
extra.minText: Rs 5,000/- and in multiple of Re.1/- thereafter
